Welcome to Matt's Preset!

Hi there!! I'm matt, and I made this awesome CSP video series — you could follow along with it, but it's a year old and kinda outdated (I've switched some solutions too), so treat this website as the more reliable source.

Before you start

1. Parity
As mentioned in part 1.5, you can +1 to your tracing for evil cases so that you would always do the good alg if you trace even. If you are very consistently getting a case wrong, just switch the odd and even algs.
2. Shape Representations
These CS shapes get a backstory to help you make stories for memorizing nice vs evil cases:
scallop = seafood muffin = innocent snack shield = physical shield kite = physical kite barrel = physical barrel square = magic spell paw = bear fist = angry person (punch)
3. Shape Evilness
Shapes have an intrinsic evilness to help with storytelling:
scallop muffin kite good paw good fist 6 4-1-1 right 4-2 3-3 8 7-1 5-3 4-4 pair shield bad paw bad fist left 4-2 6-2 L line both 5-1 (always good) 3-3 (always good) 2-2-2 (always bad)
4. Alg Angles
Every alg can be executed from the other end of the slice — if bar is solved, y2; if bar is flipped, z2. Try different angles!
